lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron to have Israel bring an unblemished red heifer to Eleazar the priest.
Eleazar has the heifer slaughtered beside the bronze altar and sprinkles its blood seven times toward the Tent of Meeting.
The heifer is burned whole, and the priest throws acacia wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool onto the fire.
A clean man stores the ashes outside the camp, and whoever touches a dead body is unclean for seven days.
Ashes go in a jar with fresh water, and a clean man sprinkles the unclean with hyssop.
